findings.title: Unmarked configs with a deliberate exclusive plugins.allow get skill-workshop added and are never stamped
findings.failure: The allowlist rule treats any unmarked config whose previous and next plugins.allow both omit skill-workshop as 'built-in era'. Configs that are hand-written or created by a first write (stampConfigWriteMetadata skips stamping when previousConfig is undefined) never get the marker; worse, stampSkillWorkshopPluginMigration now refuses to stamp on every later ordinary write because this rule always reports a change. So an operator on a current release who intentionally sets plugins.allow: ["telegram"] to harden the install sees a persistent 'needs migration' legacy warning, and openclaw doctor --fix / startup migration silently appends skill-workshop to their allowlist, turning on a plugin that loads learned skills into prompts and runs autonomous learning against their explicit policy. Before this change such a write stamped the marker and left the allowlist alone.

findings.title: Enable button stays stuck on 'Turning on…' when the enable succeeds but Workshop methods never appear
findings.failure: On a successful plugins.setEnabled the owner leaves state at {status:'off', enabling:true} and relies solely on the method catalog gaining skills.workshop.list. If the response reports restartRequired, or the plugin is enabled but fails to load/register its methods, the catalog never changes, sync() is never re-run with a new client, and the page shows a permanently disabled 'Turning on…' button with no error, no retry and no hint that a restart is needed; the result of the request (restartRequired/warnings) is discarded.
